free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: A fixed set of plain unary CPU ops; with max_nodes=0 the generation loop does not run, so the choice only fixes the module-level import graph and never changes the solver decision.

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: Default initial placeholder rank; it only creates the symbolic shape whose element count makes the zero memory limit unsatisfiable.

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: The memory constraint and the assertion are added after graph generation, so no generated ops are needed to reach the target; zero nodes removes timing-dependent graph growth and keeps both runs deterministic.

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: Default generation budget from random_model_gen; with no generation loop iterations it only sets the z3 solver timeout, which is far above the time needed for this small constraint set.

free_parameters.name: limnf
free_parameters.why: Path prefix from the Region: the memory-limit branch must be enabled for the target assertion to execute.
